name: @dsh-user/conversation-summary
description: Flexible conversation summarization/compaction driven by a scenario x authorization model: scenarios (over-budget, plan-mode exit, free-form finalization) x mode (hint=ask the user first, auto=compress directly), an agent-callable compact_conversation tool (estimate/auto/ask), a resident policy prompt (enabled scenarios + single mode authorization), and a settings-page GUI (设置→会话压缩) for reviewing/tuning the config surface. Drives the built-in durable compaction engine; the checkpoint template stays the engine's built-in one in v0.

scripts.selfcheck: node --check lib/index.js && node --check lib/client.js && echo host+client ok
